subject: Customer request: customer-managed keys (HSM) — audit artifact delivery
messages:
From: Laura Diaz <laura.diaz@velvetbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@velvetbank.com, Sam Kline <sam.kline@velvetbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: REQ: CMK/HSM evidence for SIG questionnaire — VelvetBank

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need a set of artifacts that demonstrate Redwood's handling of customer-managed keys (CMK) when customers opt to bring their own keys and use an HSM-backed key store. Specifically VelvetBank is asking for: 

- HSM vendor attestation or module certificate (redacted where necessary)
- An export of key rotation events for the past 12 months (key IDs + rotation timestamps + actor)
- A short description of the key import / BYOK handshake and protection of key material in transit
- Confirmation of at-rest key wrapping/envelope encryption scheme and AES key lengths used

Can you confirm what we can expect by EOD Tuesday and any supporting attachments you can share? We prefer a CSV for rotation events and PDFs for attestation.

Laura
Laura Diaz
Head of Information Security — VelvetBank
laura.diaz@velvetbank.com

Attachments: none

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Diaz <laura.diaz@velvetbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: REQ: CMK/HSM evidence for SIG questionnaire — VelvetBank

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Confirming we can provide the items requested. Quick plan: 

1) HSM attestation: we'll provide a vendor-signed attestation PDF (vendor serials redacted)
2) Rotation export: CSV with rotation events (we will redact full key material; will include key IDs, rotation timestamps, and initiating principal)
3) BYOK handshake: short prose summary + pointer to the BYOK runbook and KMS TLS transport logs
4) At-rest wrapping: diagram and algorithm description (envelope encryption using AES-256-GCM with RSA-OAEP-256 for wrapped key exchange on BYOK imports)

I've looped in Marissa (KeyOps) to produce the rotation export and Karthik (Security Eng) to attach the attestation and the BYOK procedural note. Expect a package by Tuesday EOD Pacific; if we can get it to you earlier we'll send incremental artifacts.

Next steps: 
- Marissa: export rotation history and attach CSV (redact serials as needed)
- Karthik: attach HSM attestation PDF + short BYOK description docx

Irene Choi
Director, Compliance & Trust — Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_cmk_plan.txt (inline summary)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Diaz <laura.diaz@velvetbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: REQ: CMK/HSM evidence for SIG questionnaire — VelvetBank

Hi all — attaching the exports and the attestation stub. Notes below.

Attached: 
- redwood_hsm_attestation_20270509.pdf (HSM vendor attestation; vendor serials redacted per contract)
- kms-rotation-export-velvetbank.csv (rotation events for the customer-provided keys; columns: key_id, rotation_time_utc, actor, reason)
- signed-sig-responses.docx (draft answers to the SIG questions specific to CMK/HSM)

Export notes / redactions: 
- We redacted HSM serial numbers and hardware identifiers to protect vendor-sensitive telemetry; the attestation still confirms FIPS and module config.
- Rotation CSV includes pseudonymized key IDs assigned at creation time; we can provide a mapping under NDA if required.
- Actors in the CSV are principal names (service_account:cmk-ops or user:marissa_cole) — we can map to employee IDs if necessary for your audit.

BYOK transport details (summary): 
- Key import occurs over mutual TLS between customer gateway and our key import endpoint; payloads are encrypted client-side and never persisted in plaintext.
- During import we perform envelope wrapping: customer key material is wrapped using a service master key in the HSM using RSA-OAEP-256, then stored encrypted.
- TLS ciphers: TLS1.3 only; AEAD cipher suites enforced.

If you need a vendor contact for the HSM or the complete module cert, let me know and I will coordinate with procurement for a release.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Key Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_hsm_attestation_20270509.pdf (application/pdf), kms-rotation-export-velvetbank.csv (text/csv), signed-sig-responses.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Sam Kline <sam.kline@velvetbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Diaz <laura.diaz@velvetbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: REQ: CMK/HSM evidence for SIG questionnaire — VelvetBank

Irene / Marissa — got the package, thanks. The CSV and the attestation PDF look good at first glance. A couple quick follow-ups from our audit team: 

- Can you confirm whether rotation events include automated rotations initiated by our configured policy vs. manual rotations? Ideally a column stating "rotation_type" (automated/manual).
- For the BYOK handshake, can you include the exact TLS cipher suite and the HSM vendor name (we can accept redacted hardware IDs)?
- Once you finalize the SIG answers docx, please sign it and return the PDF so our compliance team can drop it into the vendor portal.

If you can send a short amended CSV with rotation_type and an updated signed SIG PDF by Friday EOD we can clear the CMK section. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sam Kline
Vendor Risk — VelvetBank
